title: Day Tripper of Duluth
specs: Kayak tours explore Lake Superior's North Shore, including Split Rock Lighthouse, shipwrecks, and scenic cliffs
Canoe trips explore Superior National Forest and Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness
Mountain bike lessons taught by certified instructors with racing experience
Kayakers must be able to stand up from seated on ground without assistance and enter/exit kayak without assistance
Weight limit for kayaks: 300 lbs per solo paddler or 550 lbs total for tandem kayak plus gear
Recommended minimum age for solo kayak paddlers is 13 unless experienced; tandem kayaks available for younger children with adult
Recommended minimum age for canoe paddlers is 10 unless experienced; 'duffer' option for young children
Mountain bike lessons require own bike in good working condition
Overnight trips are private with just your group and guide; no large group tours
Mountain bike lessons can be private or small groups; clinics available for groups

includes: All camping gear including tents, sleeping bags, head lamps, and cooking gear
Kayak gear including kayak, paddle, PFD, wetsuit, and spray skirt
Canoe gear including canoe, paddle, and PFD
Food and beverages including breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, locally roasted coffee, and evening drinks
Guided tours with education on camping, kayaking, canoeing basics, and outdoors
Mountain bike skills lessons include personalized instruction and coaching
Kayak tours include kayak, paddle, PFD, wetsuits, paddling jackets, gloves (depending on water temp), and guide
gap: Exact prices for canoe camping trips not stated
blurb: Guests participate in guided kayaking, canoeing, and biking tours, as well as fully outfitted overnight camping trips with meals and gear provided. Tours are customized for groups and skill levels, with options for private trips. Activities include exploring Lake Superior, Superior National Forest, and Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness.
extraNote: Tours paddle in light rain and moderate wind/waves but will not go out if unsafe; weather changes usually not made more than 48 hours in advance · If weather is unsafe, tours will be relocated, rescheduled, or refunded · Day Tripper reserves right to cancel or reroute tours up until last minute due to weather, safety, or other uncontrollable circumstances · No refund for unused portions of tours ended early due to adverse weather · Cancellation policy applies; refunds or rescheduling offered if Day Tripper cancels · Varies by tour; common meeting points include Split Rock Lighthouse State Park, Gooseberry Falls State Park, Sawbill Trailhead, and Two Harbors boat launch. · May through October
